headlines.title_en: Valuations of hot future-industry projects change weekly; VCs pick winners amid the rush
headlines.summary_en: "Good projects are fiercely competed for, valuations keep rising!" "Just a week later, valuations have gone up again." Recently, future industries represented by AI large models and embodied intelligence have been attracting continuous capital, with primary market investors busy hunting for projects, fearing missing potential star projects. Qingke Research data shows: In the first half of 2026, equity investment market completed 5,944 investment cases, up 14.7% YoY; investment amount about 565.4 billion yuan, up 31.9% YoY. Market activity has returned to high levels. Industry sources say that since this year, venture capital institutions have significantly accelerated investment pace. Frontier hard tech is entering a technology implementation cycle, capital market continues to broaden listing paths for tech firms, multiple forces jointly boost primary market investment confidence. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 港股迎来解禁高峰
headlines.summary: 进入2026年下半年，港股市场迎来限售股解禁高峰期。多家机构测算，2026年港股全年解禁规模或接近2万亿港元，较2025年大幅增长，今年7月、9月和12月成为筹码集中释放的重要时点。不过，从历史经验及近期市场表现看，机构普遍认为，解禁不等同于减持，其影响更多集中于部分流通盘较小、解禁比例较高的个股，尚不足以对港股大盘构成系统性冲击。与此同时，南向资金在部分核心标的上仍展现出较强的定向承接力，多家上市公司的基石投资者、战略股东及管理层也主动延长锁定期或作出不减持承诺，凸显长期资金对优质港股资产的认可。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock market faces a wave of lockup expirations
headlines.summary_en: Entering the second half of 2026, the Hong Kong stock market is facing a peak period of lock-up share expirations. Multiple institutions estimate that the total value of shares unlocked in 2026 could approach 2 trillion Hong Kong dollars, up significantly from 2025, with July, September and December being key months for concentrated share releases. However, based on historical experience and recent market performance, institutions generally believe that unlocking does not equal selling, with impact more concentrated on individual stocks with small circulating caps and high unlocking ratios, insufficient to cause systemic shock to the Hong Kong market overall. Meanwhile, southbound funds still show strong targeted absorption capacity for some core stocks, and several listed companies' cornerstone investors, strategic shareholders, and management have proactively extended lock-up periods or made no-sale commitments, highlighting long-term capital's recognition of quality Hong Kong stock assets. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 美国禁止进口中国新型机器人和电力逆变器
headlines.summary: 美国联邦通讯委员会(FCC)公布，将禁止从中国及其他被认定构成国家安全威胁的国家进口新型号人形机器人和四足机器人，还将禁止中国产逆变器的新机型。该机构的声明表示，外国制造的机器人可能被敌对国家用于监视美国民众、提升外国情报机构能力，甚至远程控制机器人本身。 路透引述美国官员称，有关禁令以保护美国人工智能(AI)基础设施建设免受国家安全威胁，并推动预计将高速增长的关键产业回流美国。官员指出，总统已经明确表示，美国必须为机器人设备、电力逆变器等关键和新兴技术建立独立且安全的供应链。经济安全就是国家安全，特朗普政府正继续通过细致且多层面的政策议程推动美国再工业

headlines.title_en: US bans imports of new Chinese robots and power inverters
headlines.summary_en: US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announced it will ban imports of new models of humanoid robots and quadrupeds from China and other countries deemed national security threats, also will ban new models of Chinese-made inverters. The agency's statement said foreign-made robots could be used by hostile nations to surveil Americans, enhance foreign intelligence capabilities, or even remotely control the robots themselves. Reuters cited US officials saying the ban aims to protect US AI infrastructure from national security threats and promote reshoring of key industries expected to grow rapidly. Officials said the president has made clear the US must build an independent and secure supply chain for key and emerging technologies like robot equipment and power inverters. Economic security is national security, and the Trump administration continues to advance US reindustrialization through a detailed, multi-faceted policy agenda.

headlines.title_en: [A-share Thermometer] Sentiment indicators: leverage ratio rebounds, turnover barely holds above 2 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en:
1. Total trading volume in Shanghai and Shenzhen markets on July 28 slightly fell to 2.03 trillion yuan, the 12th consecutive day below the 20-day moving average (2.73 trillion yuan).
2. On July 28, the A-share leverage ratio, measured by margin buying as a share of A-share free-float market cap, rose back to 9.1%, continuing to fluctuate sharply around 10%, at the lower end of the past year's range.
--------
Note: 1. Two-market trading volume reflects views of institutions, hot money, and retail investors on A-shares; above average means higher volume and optimistic sentiment, below means lower volume and cooling sentiment.
2. Since 2015, A-share leverage has mostly been between 6%-10%; above 10% indicates high market activity, possibly near or in a bull market. Below 6% indicates significant deleveraging, possibly near a market bottom.

headlines.title_en: Securities firms see 22.3% QoQ rise in client complaints in Q2
headlines.summary_en: Industry sources say the Securities Association of China recently reported to the industry on securities firms' complaint handling in Q2 2026, serving as a warning for the hot market: when A-share average daily turnover hit 2.88 trillion yuan and margin balance briefly exceeded 3 trillion yuan in Q2, investor complaints also rose accordingly. Data shows Q2 industry-wide received 9,610 client complaints, up 22.3% QoQ; despite rising total complaints, resolution rate remained high, with 8,888 resolved in the period, a 92.5% resolution rate. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: AI算力需求催热上半年业绩，行业人士称MLCC产业链高景气度下半年将延续
headlines.summary: 今年以来，受益于AI算力需求爆发，素有“电子工业大米”之称的MLCC（片式多层陶瓷电容器）供应紧俏，价格持续上涨，带动被动元器件行业景气度回升，多家上市公司预计上半年业绩实现大幅增长，最高增幅超过6倍。展望下半年，有行业人士表示，7月以来，MLCC价格整体平稳，品类内部价格则分化加剧，AI和车规级高端高容产品价格继续上涨。在AI服务器需求旺盛、原厂产能被锁定、上游贵金属等原材料价格居高的背景下，预计下半年高端高容MLCC价格将继续上涨，并有望推高被动元器件市场整体景气度。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: AI computing demand boosts first-half earnings; industry sources say MLCC supply chain to maintain high sentiment in H2
headlines.summary_en: This year, benefiting from the explosion in AI computing demand, MLCCs (multilayer ceramic capacitors), known as 'rice of the electronics industry', have become tight in supply with prices rising continuously, driving a recovery in the passive components industry, with many listed companies expecting significant first-half profit growth, some up over 600%. Looking to the second half, industry insiders say since July, MLCC prices have been overall stable but diverging within categories, with AI and automotive-grade high-end high-capacitance prices continuing to rise. Given strong AI server demand, locked-up original factory capacity, and high precious metal raw material prices, high-end high-capacitance MLCC prices are expected to continue rising in the second half, likely boosting overall passive component market sentiment. (Shanghai Securities News)
